summary.status: Pre-JO rankings pilot with team-depth guardrails
modelAdjustments: Applied same-club hierarchy protection so A-level teams stay above B/C/D teams from the same club unless future evidence warrants review.
Applied distribution caps so B teams can pass weaker A teams but do not crowd the top of the rankings.
Excluded 12U_COED_GIRLS evidence from the 12U Boys pilot.
Capped coed-only profiles unless boys-specific evidence exists.
Capped D2/Gold-heavy profiles when D1/qualifier validation is mixed or negative.
Preserved lower-division credit so a dominant Gold/Silver winner can be treated like a possible low-D1 team, not an automatic elite-D1 team.
modelNotes: Manual review layer added: Greenwich prioritized for elite SD County Cup wins; San Jose Express Blue/North Irvine Black adjusted lower; San Clemente profiles lowered and flagged for split-profile review.
Same-team aliases for club color/name variants are manually merged before publication.
Public rankings now use a same-team alias layer before rank publication.
Ranking page must render one age/gender group at a time; all-groups ranking views are disabled.
Home page ranking finder routes users directly to a selected age/gender rankings view.
manualAdjustments: Merged San Clemente A + San Clemente Black.
Merged Rose Bowl Red + Rose Bowl.
Moved CDM and 680 A down based on recency and major-tournament validation.
Weighted recent major events and D1 evidence above early-season isolated wins.
Merged CC United A and CC United Black into a single CC United 12U Boys profile.
Merged CDM and CDM Blue as same primary 12U Boys team.
Merged Foothill Red and Foothill Club as same primary 12U Boys team.
Merged San Diego Shores / SD Shores / SD Shores Black naming variants.
Merged ORWP A and ORWP as the same primary 12U Boys team.
Merged 908 and 908 Blue as the same primary 12U Boys team.
Merged LA Premier and LA Premier Black as the same primary 12U Boys team.
Merged OCWPC Blue and OCWPC as the same primary 12U Boys team.
Merged NorCal and NorCal Black as the same primary 12U Boys team.
Merged Patriot Navy and Patriot A as the same primary 12U Boys team.
Promoted Lamorinda A into the top-25 review band after confirming Lamorinda A / Lamorinda Blue naming context and parent review input.
Preserved primary A-team/B-team guardrails; B/C teams may rank above lower primary teams only with strong evidence.
